D5/S3/QuantumBounds/FubiniStudyRecordTim.signature: theorem record_count_upper_bound (N : ℕ) (a m₀ m₁ : Fin N → E) (ha : ∀ i, ‖a i‖ = 1) (h₀ : ∀ i, ‖m₀ i‖ = 1) (h₁ : ∀ i, ‖m₁ i‖ = 1) (horth : ∀ i, inner ℂ (m₀ i) (m₁ i) = 0) (energy hbar T : ℝ) (τ : Fin N → ℝ) (henergy : 0 < energy) (hhbar : 0 < hbar) (speed₀ : ∀ i, fsAngle (a i) (m₀ i) ≤ energy * τ i / hbar) (speed₁ : ∀ i, fsAngle (a i) (m₁ i) ≤ energy * τ i / hbar) (budget : ∑ i, τ i ≤ T) : (N : ℝ) ≤ 4 * energy * T / (Real.pi * hbar)
